### UnitRuntime

An object to represent a unit's runtime information

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Following` | `?string` | If not empty, the field contains the name of another unit that this unit follows in state |
| `LoadState` | `?string` | Reflects whether the configuration file of this unit has been loaded |
| `ActiveState` | `?string` | Reflects whether the unit is currently active or not |
| `FreezerState` | `?string` | Reflects whether the unit is currently frozen or not |
| `SubState` | `?string` | Reflect more fine-grained state that is unit-type-specific |
| `UnitFileState` | `?string` | Reflects the install state of the unit file |
| `StateChangeTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the firmware first began execution |
| `ActiveEnterTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the unit entered active state |
| `ActiveExitTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the unit exited active state |
| `InactiveEnterTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the unit entered inactive state |
| `InactiveExitTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | Timestamp when the unit exited inactive state |
| `CanStart` | `?bool` | Reflects whether the unit can be started or not |
| `CanStop` | `?bool` | Reflects whether the unit can be stopped or not |
| `CanReload` | `?bool` | Reflects whether the unit can be reloaded or not |
| `CanIsolate` | `?bool` | Reflects whether the unit may be started in isolation mode |
| `CanClean` | `?[]string` | Returns which unit resources can be cleaned up |
| `CanFreeze` | `?bool` | Whether the unit supports the freeze operation |
| `CanLiveMount` | `?bool` | Whether the unit supports live mounting |
| `JobId` | `?int` | The job ID of the job currently scheduled or being executed for this unit, if there is any. |
| `NeedDaemonReload` | `?bool` | Whether the configuration file this unit is loaded from (i.e. FragmentPath or SourcePath) has changed since the configuration was read and hence whether a configuration reload is recommended |
| `ConditionResult` | `?bool` | Condition result of the last time the configured conditions of this unit were checked |
| `AssertResult` | `?bool` | Assert result of the last time the configured asserts of this unit were checked |
| `ConditionTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | The last time the configured conditions of the unit have been checked |
| `AssertTimestamp` | `?Timestamp` | The last time the configured asserts of the unit have been checked |
| `InvocationID` | `?string` | Current invocation ID |
| `Markers` | `?[]string` | Reflects whether the unit has been marked for reload, restart, etc. |
| `ActivationDetails` | `?[]ActivationDetails` | Provides details about why a unit was activated |
| `CGroup` | `?CGroupRuntime` | The cgroup runtime of the unit |

## Errors

| Error | Go type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NoSuchUnit` | `NoSuchUnitError` | No matching unit found |
| `UnitMasked` | `UnitMaskedError` | The unit is masked |
| `UnitError` | `UnitError` | Unit is in a fatal error state |
| `PropertyNotSupported` | `PropertyNotSupportedError` | Changing this property via SetProperties() is not supported |
| `OnlyByDependency` | `OnlyByDependencyError` | Job for the unit may only be enqueued by dependencies |
| `DBusShuttingDown` | `DBusShuttingDownError` | A unit that requires D-Bus cannot be started as D-Bus is shutting down |
